import pandas as pd, numpy as np
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
sub=df[(df.account_id=='tVENWJP')&(df.cloud_service=='l5O5g')&(df.application!='d7I')]
p=sub.pivot_table(index='date',columns='instance_family',values='unblended_cost',aggfunc='sum').fillna(0)
pre=p.loc[:'2025-09-21']; post=p.loc['2025-09-22':]
for c in p.columns:
    m1,s1=pre[c].mean(),pre[c].std(); m2,s2=post[c].mean(),post[c].std()
    z=(m2-m1)/np.sqrt((s1**2+s2**2)/2) if s1+s2>0 else 0
    if abs(z)>3 or abs(m2-m1)>10: print(c, round(m1,1), round(s1,1), round(m2,1), round(s2,1), round(z,2))
